comment: The shipped manual documents the 16-track layout only, and this model packs its CV jacks differently, so the four affected lines each carry a clause saying so. On the 16-track expander one poly jack carries one aux send's levels for all sixteen tracks; here each jack carries two auxes for eight tracks, aux A on channels 1 to 8 and aux B on 9 to 16, then aux C and aux D the same way. The 16-track expander mutes track sends on one jack and group sends on another; here one jack takes the eight tracks on channels 1 to 8 and the two groups on channels 9 and 10. The group send level jack packs two groups per aux, on channels 1 and 2, 3 and 4, 5 and 6, and 7 and 8, where the 16-track version uses four channels per aux. The bus CV cable carries three different kinds of voltage: the four global sends at a tenth of a volt per unit, then the four return pans, which the source marks as -5V to +5V, then the four return volumes clamped to 0 to 10V. Input index 12 is declared in the source but is not drawn on this panel.
